svg.title: Relative relevance and likelihood
svg.desc: ten-item relative-relevance key; primary sample; E1 adjusted model; later-selected measure Arrows: unstandardized coefficients and robust Wald95% intervals. Dashed intervals include zero. Measured associations do not establish causal mediation. S1 relative relevance was selected after registered results and rated after ruling.
